description: Na₂Al₂Si₃(HO₅)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent H and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.59 Å) and one longer (2.65 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.56 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.79 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. H is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one Si atom.
